LESSON: DECIMALS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.7: Decimals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Decimals, part of Numbers in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do you use decimals in real life? 2. Why is ordering of decimals important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Work out in purposive groups/pairs place value of decimals up to thousandths using a place value chart. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional part of the body or assistive technology such adapted writing materials to work out decimals. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Work out in purposive groups/pairs place value of decimals up to thousandths using a place value chart. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional part of the body or assistive technology such adapted writing materials to work out decimals. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Decimals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Unity: as the learner collaborates with peers to find information on application of decimals in real life situations

Social justice: the learner enhances social justice when sharing information on the application of decimals in real life situations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: as the learner collaborates with peers to find information on application of decimals.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate the concept of decimal numbers to reading quantities of ingredients in Agriculture and Nutrition.
